title: vacUUUm — Product design
summary: A cordless vacuum cleaner developed through virtual prototyping in Siemens NX.
overview: A consumer-product design study, from market comparison and requirements to a complete CAD assembly.
constraints: The concept considered ergonomics, autonomy, assembly and manufacturable geometries.
contribution: A two-person academic project; this page describes the team’s product-design work.
approach: The technical portfolio describes subsystem concept generation, NX modelling, exploded views, drawings and vibration-isolation design.
results: The reported output is a virtual product design and technical documentation, not a tested commercial vacuum cleaner.
limits: Performance requirements such as autonomy and noise are distinct from measured performance. Acoustic FEM was not part of the described study.
